data.title: Marquise Square
data.about:
Marquise square is nestled in the business hub of Dubai, Business Bay. It has serves the most amazing views of the Burj Khalifa, Downtown Dubai and Canal. 

Choose from studios, 1-3 BR apartments. With a guaranteed return of 7% for 5 years this is a brilliant investment opportunity. The interiors are luxurious and have high-end finishing.

characteristics_module.title: A development that offers spectacular views of the Burj Khalifa
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Earn 7% Guaranteed Returns for 5 years
  • Pay over 3 years after handover
  • Ready to move in studios, 1-3 BR apartments
  • Stunning views of the Canal, Burj Khalifa, and Downtown Dubai
  • Studios start at AED 847K
  • Risk-free investment

location_tile.title: Located in Burj Khalifa District
location_tile.description:
Marquise Square is located in Business Bay. It is very easily accessible and has the best views of the Burj Khalifa, the canal as well as Downtown Dubai.

  • 5 mins – Dubai Mall
  • 8 mins – Burj Khalifa & DIFC
  • 14 mins – Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary
  • 16 mins – Dubai Creek Harbour
  • 18 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 20 mins – Palm Jumeirah

seo.metaDescription: Get a 7% return for 5 years at Marquise Square. Luxurious studio to 3-bedroom apartments with high-end finishes make this an ideal investment.
